tools.name: assist_document
tools.description: Rewrite, shorten, fix grammar, or apply a custom instruction to markdown via FlatWrite Assist (Morph: Reflex + Router + Compact + Fast Models). Returns full markdown plus the edited piece. Does not modify the editor — apply with update_document_content if desired. When selectionStart and selectionEnd are provided, only that span is rewritten.

markdown.description: Full markdown document. Optional in the browser WebMCP path (defaults to the active editor). Required for server MCP.

instruction.description: Freeform instruction. Required when mode is "custom".

selectionStart.description: Optional selection start index (inclusive) within markdown.

selectionEnd.description: Optional selection end index (exclusive) within markdown.

selectionText.description: Optional selection text (defaults to markdown.slice(start, end)).

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new blank document in the FlatWrite editor, optionally with initial markdown content. Use this to start a new document; use open_document to load an existing one from a URL or share link.

markdown.description: Optional initial markdown content for the new document.

title.description: Optional title for the new document.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Create a shareable URL for the active document and copy it to the clipboard. Use this to share the document; the link expires after 30 days. Use get_document_state to check canShare before calling.

tools.name: export_document_html
tools.description: Export the active document as a self-contained HTML file. The export opens in a new browser tab for human users. Completes synchronously. Use export_document_pdf for print-ready output.

tools.name: export_document_pdf
tools.description: Export the active document as a PDF by triggering the browser print dialog with the rendered preview. Completes synchronously. The print dialog opens for human users. Use export_document_html for a downloadable HTML file.

tools.name: get_document_state
tools.description: Return the current state of the active document in the FlatWrite editor: title, word count, render mode, unsaved changes flag, and available export formats. Use this before export or share tools to check readiness; use update_document_content to change the content.

tools.name: list_recent_documents
tools.description: Return a list of recently opened documents from the editor session. Use this to discover what the user has been working on; use open_document to load one.

tools.name: list_render_options
tools.description: Return the supported fonts, UI frameworks, document engines, page sizes, orientations, margins, and surface modes for the render_markdown tool. Call this before rendering if you need to know which enum values are valid; call render_markdown when you have the options and are ready to render.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open an existing document from a URL or share link in the FlatWrite editor. Use this to load a remote markdown file or a previously shared document; use create_document to start blank.

url.description: URL of the markdown file or FlatWrite share link to open.

tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Render markdown into FlatWrite-styled HTML <head> and <body> fragments, with optional typography and page-layout controls. Provide either the raw markdown inline (`markdown`) or an allowlisted URL (`markdownUrl`) pointing to raw markdown content. Use this when you need the rendered HTML artifacts.

markdownUrl.description: URL pointing to raw markdown content. Must be on an allowlisted host (raw.githubusercontent.com, raw.gitlab.com, bitbucket.org), http(s) only, and <=1 MB. Host validation is enforced server-side.

font.description: Font family — must be a bundled family.

size.description: Font size as a scale token (e.g. "-1", "0", "1").

weight.description: Font weight as a scale token (e.g. "-1", "0").

line.description: Line height as a scale token (e.g. "-1", "0", "1").

uiZoom.description: UI zoom level (1.0 = default; >1 zooms in, <1 zooms out).

pageSize.description: Page size for paged output. Only effective when docEngine is pagedjs or vivliostyle.

marginsLR.description: Left/right page margin preset. Only effective when docEngine is pagedjs or vivliostyle.

marginsTB.description: Top/bottom page margin preset. Only effective when docEngine is pagedjs or vivliostyle.

footer.description: Include a page-number footer in paged output.

width.description: Content width in pixels (400..1400). Only effective when docEngine="none".

docEngine.description: Document engine — "none" emits plain CSS; "pagedjs"/"vivliostyle" wrap the output in @page rules.

surfaceMode.description: Surface mode hint. "app" unlocks the appFramework picker; otherwise this is metadata only.

theme.description: Theme identifier rendered as body[data-theme="..."] so consumer CSS can theme via attribute selectors. Free-form (alphanumeric, dash, underscore) — common values are "light" and "dark".

tools.name: render_markdown_preview
tools.description: Triggers the editor's built-in preview pane. No HTML is returned — this tool produces a visual side-effect only. Agents that need HTML output must use render_markdown instead.

markdown.description: Optional markdown to preview. If omitted, previews the current editor content.

tools.name: update_document_content
tools.description: Update the markdown content of the active document in the FlatWrite editor. Use this to edit the document programmatically; use get_document_state to inspect the result.

markdown.description: New markdown content for the document.
